title: Hold a carrier licence to run a telecommunications network
what: The owner of a network unit (a line link, or a radiocommunications or satellite facility) used to supply carriage services to the public needs a carrier licence from the ACMA, or a nominated carrier declaration.

sources.title: Telecommunications Act 1997
sources.quote: (1) If there is only one owner of a network unit, the owner of the network unit must not use the unit, either alone or jointly with one or more other persons, to supply a carriage service to the public, unless: (a) the owner holds a carrier licence;

sources.title: Telecommunications Act 1997
sources.quote: 56 Grant of licence (1) After considering an application, the ACMA may grant a carrier licence in accordance with the application.
